body.statement: For every rule \(\ell\), \(\widehat\tau_{\ell}-\tau=a_{\ell}^{\mathsf T}\theta\) and \(\mathbb E_{\ell}[(\widehat\tau_{\ell}-\tau)^2]=\theta^{\mathsf T}Q_{\ell}\theta\).
body.justification: The quadratic retains selection bias, random denominators, and assignment variance in one design-computable object.
body.gap: Shi, Yang, Qin, and Li bound RDIM mean squared error by a surrogate rather than state the exact endpoint quadratic.
body.consumer: Exact graph-only rule selection needs a loss matrix that remains valid for heterogeneous fixed potential outcomes.
